# Which travel nurse offer actually pays more?

> Free calculator that compares travel nurse and locum contract offers by real take-home pay. Enter taxable rate, stipends, guaranteed hours, housing, travel and gaps between assignments for up to three offers. Runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
